Converter.ConvertToHtml.error: IOException: The process cannot access the file 'input-single.html' because it is being used by another process.
Converter.ConvertToHtml.root_cause: FILE_LOCK — FolderOutputHandler writes output file then holds a file lock during the async pipeline. The harness tries to read bytes while the stream is still open.
Converter.ConvertToHtml.fix_strategy: Use a fresh FileStream per conversion. FolderOutputHandler internal behavior holds lock until disposal. Harness reads output BEFORE handler is disposed.
Converter.ConvertToHtml.impact_on_pipeline: NONE — pipeline generated examples write to their own output paths; file-lock only occurs in harness multi-test sequence
